_note: icrl allowlist (DESIGN.md sec 4). {kind} expands to food and goods; by_kind overrides per kind. categories.* = any category in the 24 h market stats (or an existing override). max_step = absolute step, max_ratio = multiplicative step; with both, the larger move is allowed. buyer.max_shops tops out at 8 because policy.validate refuses more. An entry may override protocol / block_steps; otherwise its family's apply. Fixed keys are enforced in icrl/space.py, not here. forum: buyer side (Buyer ALL scores buyer posts); forum.enabled and forum.interval_s (300 s = the kit limit) are never listed; rotate >= 1 because forum.py slices recent_cats[-rotate:]; max_refs <= 8, the largest value the kit has accepted; window_h <= 6 bounds the forum_state buffer.
